detail.title: 一种拆卸触摸屏的治具
detail.abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of tool dismantling touch-screen, comprise main body, holddown groove, sucker, vacuum valve, lift cylinder and electric control gear, described holddown groove is arranged at body top, body top is provided with opening in holddown groove, described vacuum valve, lift cylinder, electric control gear are all located at body interior, connect the telescopic head of lift cylinder bottom described sucker, are provided with through hole at the bottom of described sucker, suction cup interior is communicated with vacuum valve by bottom through-hole, and sucker stretches out from the opening part of body top; Described electric control gear is connected with lift cylinder, and control the lifting of lift cylinder, the beneficial effects of the utility model are, owing to have employed full-automatic equipment operating, save artificial, substantially increase removal efficiency, and can not touch-screen be damaged, improve dismounting quality.
assignees: 东莞华贝电子科技有限公司
